BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to preventing animal cruelty; adding new sectionsto chapter 9A.44 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9A.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person commits the crime of sexual assault of an animal ifthe person: (a) Touches or contacts, or causes an object or another person totouch or contact, the mouth, anus, or sex organs of an animal for thepurpose of arousing or gratifying the sexual desire of a person; or (b) Causes an animal to touch or contact the mouth, anus, or sexorgans of a person for the purpose of arousing or gratifying the sexualdesire of a person. (2) Sexual assault of an animal is a gross misdemeanor.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9A.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Upon the conviction of a defendant for a violation of section 1 ofthis act, the court, in addition to any other sentence imposed, shall p. 1 HB 2219order the defendant to undergo a psychiatric or psychologicalevaluation and, if warranted by the mental condition of the defendant,undergo appropriate care or treatment. The defendant shall bear thecosts of the evaluation and treatment.
